CM APPL. 19580/2023 -Delay 59 days 3.
This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 59 days delay in filing the appeal.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent nos.1 to 5 and respondent no.9, who are the only contesting respondents appear on advance notice and fairly do not oppose the application.
5. The application is, accordingly, for the reasons stated therein, allowed and the delay of 59 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
6. The application stands disposed of.
7. The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act seeks to assail the award dated 07.11.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.
8. Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent nos.1 to 5 and respondent no.9 accept notice.

sentences.text: Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondent nos.6 to 8 through all permissible modes.
10.The TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
11.List on 12.10.2023 along with MAC.APP.153/2023 CM APPL. 19578/2023 -Stay 12.This is an application filed by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

13.Taking into account that the primary grievance of the appellant is that it is the respondent no.9/Reliance General Insurance Co. Ltd., which is liable to pay the entire compensation and not merely 50% as directed under the impugned award, I am of the view that the claimants cannot on account of this interse dispute between the two insurance companies be made to suffer.
14.I, therefore, find no reason to stay the operation of the impugned award.
The present application is, accordingly, dismissed.
Consequently, the appellant is directed to deposit with the learned Tribunal the amount in accordance with the impugned award within six weeks from today.
15.It is, however, made clear that the payment, made to the claimants will remain subject to outcome of the present appeal.
